articles.title: Plasma: Arc Filament
articles.summary: Matte charcoal black crossed by thin pink-orange glowing filaments, like an electric arc web on dark. A dark car with a loud orange scribble of long lines and pink hot spots; reads like a web of glowing wires or pick-up-sticks.
articles.what: Past burning: an ionised channel that carries current, not fuel. Up close: Dark navy ground crossed by long, nearly straight copper-orange filaments 3-8 px wide, crossing at all angles. Where filaments are thickest the core turns lilac-pink with small knots at the crossings, and fainter hairline whiskers sprout around them. From a distance: A dark car with a loud orange scribble of long lines and pink hot spots; reads like a web of glowing wires or pick-up-sticks. Measured spec (average): metal 42, roughness 199, coat 204. Shine: matte. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
